name: Sports & Games
summary: Olympics, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, Cricket World Cups, Trophies, and Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna.
concept: Covers India's Olympic accomplishments (from K. D. Jadhav's bronze in 1952, Abhinav Bindra's shooting gold in 2008, Neeraj Chopra's javelin golds in Tokyo 2020 & World Athletics 2023), cricket achievements (1983, 2011 ODI World Cups, 2007, 2024 T20 World Cups), domestic trophies (Ranji, Duleep, Santosh, Thomas Cup), and National Sports Day on 29 August.

subtopics.name: Olympic Records & Heroes
subtopics.summary: Individual golds, hockey dominance, athletics milestones.

facts.title: Neeraj Chopra Olympic Gold
facts.content: Neeraj Chopra won independent India's first-ever Olympic track and field gold medal in Men's Javelin Throw at Tokyo 2020 with an 87.58 m throw.

facts.title: Abhinav Bindra First Individual Gold
facts.content: Abhinav Bindra won India's first-ever individual Olympic gold medal in the 10m Air Rifle event at Beijing 2008.

mcqs.q: National Sports Day in India is celebrated every year on August 29 in commemoration of the birth anniversary of which legend?
mcqs.exp: Major Dhyan Chand, the 'Wizard of Hockey', led India to Olympic gold medals in 1928, 1932, and 1936.

mcqs.q: Who was the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal?
mcqs.exp: Weightlifter Karnam Malleswari won bronze in the 69 kg weightlifting category at the Sydney 2000 Olympics.
